-- Edited by Harbinger451
-- StartsBy: Commoner
-- Questee: anyone
Quest: FetchWood02
DisplayName: Source a Supply of Firewood
-- Message panels
QRC:

QuestorOffer:  [1000]
<ce> You look like you don't mind getting your hands dirty!
<ce> I have a spot of work, if you're interested?
<--->
<ce> How do you feel about doing some honest
<ce> salt-of-the-earth labor, %ra?
<ce> It pays well.
<--->
<ce> I'm in need of someone willing to do some
<ce> menial but well paid laboring!
<ce> Might you fit the bill?

RefuseQuest:  [1001]
<ce> That's the trouble with people these days.
<ce> Afraid of good old-fashioned hard work.
<--->
<ce> I should've known better than to ask a %ra!

AcceptQuest:  [1002]
<ce> I'm running short of firewood, you see.
<ce> I simply don't have the time to chop 'n' collect
<ce> it myself, far too busy for that. Anyway, if you
<ce> can get me four wood bundles before =deadline_ days
<ce> have passed, I'll reward you with _reward_ gold.
<ce> Get 'em however you like, makes no difference to me
<ce> ... just be sure to get 'em.
<--->
<ce> I really need to get some firewood,
<ce> but who has the time to go out 'n' chop
<ce> wood for themselves. Especially with the
<ce> wilderness being such a dangerous place.
<ce> If you bring me four bundles of wood within
<ce> lets say =deadline_ days, I'll pay you _reward_ gold.

QuestFail:  [1003]
<ce> You have failed to get _questgiver_
<ce> %g3 firewood in time!

QuestComplete:  [1004]
<ce> Oh, good job, %pcn.
<ce> For these four wood bundles, here's
<ce> your _reward_ gold as promised.
<--->
<ce> My firewood ... nicely chopped and everything!
<ce> Well done, %pcf. Here's your _reward_ gold.

QuestorPostsuccess:  [1008]
Hello %pcf. You did a fine job getting me that firewood. What can I do for you?

QuestLogEntry:  [1010]
%qdt
_questgiver_ of __questgiver_ 
at ___questgiver_
has asked me to collect four wood bundles
before =deadline_ days have passed.
I will be paid _reward_ gold for all four of them.

Message:  1011
%qdt
_questgiver_ of __questgiver_ 
at ___questgiver_
paid me _reward_ gold for four wood bundles.

Message:  1012
<ce> You don't have the four wood bundles I asked for.
<ce> Come back when you have them all ...
<ce> and not before.
<--->
<ce> Stop waisting my time, %pcn!
<ce> Come back when you have the four wood bundles.

Message:  1013
<ce> You have the four wood bundles
<ce> that _questgiver_ of __questgiver_ 
<ce> at ___questgiver_ requires.


QBN:

Person _questgiver_ group Questor

Clock _deadline_ 72:00

Item _reward_ gold range 400 to 600

--	Quest start-up:
	log 1010 step 0
	start timer _deadline_

variable _deadline_

_questgiverclicked_ task:
	clicked npc _questgiver_

_gotitem_ task:
	player possesses 4 items class 20 subclass 1604
	say 1013

_success_ task:
	when _questgiverclicked_ and _gotitem_
	player handsover 4 items class 20 subclass 1604
	give pc _reward_
    remove log step 0
	log 1011 step 1
	clear _questgiverclicked_
	end quest

_failure_ task:
	when _questgiverclicked_ and not _gotitem_
	say 1012
	clear _questgiverclicked_

_timeout_ task:
	when _deadline_ and not _success_
	say 1003
    remove log step 0
	end quest
